generic_domain.justification: Reinforcement learning is a general framework in machine learning where an agent learns to make decisions by interacting with an environment and receiving rewards or penalties. It encompasses various specialized areas like contextual reinforcement learning and visual reinforcement learning. Contextual RL deals with scenarios where additional context influences the decision-making process, while visual RL focuses on environments where vision-based inputs are crucial. Since both of these domains fall under the broader umbrella of reinforcement learning, selecting 'reinforcement_learning' as the most generic domain makes sense. It provides a comprehensive framework that can accommodate and integrate other specific areas within it.
